export.title: Download my data
export.body: A ZIP of everything you have entered here, as four files you can open in any spreadsheet. We build it in the background, so this can take a moment on a long history.
export.queued: Queued — we have your request and nothing has been built yet.
export.readyBody: {count} entries went in, {deleted} of them from the bin.
export.failed: That archive could not be built. Nothing has changed — try again.
export.linkSpent: That link has been used. Ask for a new one whenever you need it again.
export.expires: The link works once, and stops working {hours} hours after it is handed out.
export.oneTime: A download link can only be used once, and it only ever belongs to you.
export.filesNote: The amounts are exactly as they are stored, unconverted.
export.currencyNote: Every amount is in {code}, the currency your ledger is kept in — not the currency the app was showing. Nothing in the file has been converted.
export.neverRun: You have not asked for an archive yet.
export.errorBuildFailed: The archive could not be built. Try again in a moment.
export.errorExpired: That archive has been cleaned up. Ask for a new one.
export.errorInterrupted: That archive was interrupted and never finished. Ask for a new one.
del.title: Delete my account
del.body: This is permanent, so it asks for your password and then waits a week. Nothing is removed during those seven days, and you can change your mind at any point before the end of them.
del.passwordHelp: Type it again so we know it is really you.
del.reasonHelp: Optional. It is kept with the request and not used for anything else.
del.dangerTitle: Last chance to change your mind
del.confirmBody: In {days} days your account closes. Your entries, categories, budgets, wishlist, recurring entries and wallets are deleted then. Any group you are in keeps its books, and you stay in it as a former member so the other balances do not move.
del.pendingBody: That is {days} days from now. Nothing has been deleted yet.
del.pendingNote: Asking again will not move the date, and the seven days do not start over. Cancelling clears it completely and changes nothing else.
del.keeping: Good — your account stays exactly as it is.
del.scheduled: Your account closes on {date}. You can cancel it any time before then.
del.formerMemberNote: A group you were in keeps its bills, settlements and journal exactly as they are, and your row in the members list is kept so every other balance stays the same. Your name and email are removed from that row.
guard.card.title: Guardian summary
guard.card.subtitle: Share one month of totals with one person, and take it back whenever you like.
guard.card.statusNone: Nobody has been set up yet.
guard.card.statusOn: Set up for {email}. You agreed to this on {when}.
guard.card.emailHelp: Nobody is emailed for you — you send the link yourself, and you can take it back at any time.
guard.consent.line: Tick this to let {email} see one month of totals from this account: what was spent in each category, how much of each budget is used, and your savings goal. They will not see a single entry, shop, receipt, date, note, or anything else on your account.
guard.consent.tick: I have read this and agree to share it
guard.consent.blocked: Tick the agreement above before a link can be made.
guard.issue.notConsented: Tick the agreement above before a link can be made.
guard.issue.emailMissing: Enter the email address of the person you want to share this with.
guard.issue.emailInvalid: That does not look like an email address.
guard.issue.emailTooLong: That email address is too long.
guard.issue.emailOwn: That is your own address. This summary is meant for somebody else.
guard.issued.title: Your link is ready
guard.issued.once: The link is shown once and cannot be shown again. Copy it now.
guard.issued.month: It shows {month}, the month you are in now.
guard.revoke.help: This kills the link immediately and forgets the address. It cannot be undone.
guard.preview.label: What {email} will see
guard.toast.revoked: The link is dead and the address is gone.
guard.summary.heading: The spending summary for {name}
guard.summary.currency: All amounts are in {currency}, the currency this account is kept in.
guard.summary.frozen: These figures are for {month}, the month the link was made. The page does not follow the calendar: next month it will still show {month}.
guard.summary.disclaimer: This is a summary, not the whole picture: three totals for one month. For anything more — what was bought, when, or with whom — ask {name}.
guard.section.categoriesNote: Totals for the whole month. No dates, and no individual entries.
guard.section.budgetsNote: The share of each budget that has been used. The limit itself is not shared.
guard.empty.budgets: No budget was set for this month.
guard.savings.noGoal: No savings goal has been set, so there is nothing to compare against.
guard.savings.nothingSaved: Nothing was saved this month — more came out than came in.
guard.savings.short: {saved} saved so far this month, towards a goal of {goal}.
guard.savings.met: The goal of {goal} was reached this month, with {saved} left over.
guard.view.goneBody: It has expired, or the person who made it has taken it back. Ask them for a new link if you need to see it again.
guard.view.readOnly: Read-only. Nothing on this page can be changed, and it is not an account — there is nothing to sign in to.
invite.copyManual: The link is in the box above — select it and copy it by hand.
invite.onePerson: A code is for ONE person. It works once, and it stops working for anybody else.
invite.oneOut: There is already a code out there for this group.
invite.codeGone: We only ever show a code on the screen that made it, so it cannot be written down from here. Revoke it and make a new one if you need to print it again.
invite.whereToPost: Put the code where {name} will see it, or send the link to one person directly.
invite.qrAlt: QR code for joining this group
invite.scanToJoin: Scan this with your phone camera to join the group. It is for one person only.
invite.groupFull: This group already holds {max} people, so a new invite could not be accepted. Add a roommate from the form above instead.
invite.alreadyMember: You are already in this group.
invite.expired: This invite link has expired, or it has already been used.
invite.liveExists: This group already has a code out there. Revoke it first if you want to make a new one — the code somebody has already shared keeps working until you do.
invite.groupClosed: This group is closed, so a new invite cannot be made.
invite.groupGone: This group no longer exists, so the invite cannot be used.
invite.noGroup: We could not find that group.
invite.noInvite: That invite does not belong to this group.
invite.noPermission: Only the group owner or an admin can make an invite code for this group.
invite.tooManyTries: You have opened a lot of invite links just now. Please wait {waitMinutes} minutes and try again.
invite.error: Something went wrong with that invite. Please try again.
invite.confirmCount: {n} people are in this group now.
invite.notPromotion: An invite is not a promotion. The owner can raise your role afterwards from the members list.
invite.signInFirst: Sign in first, so the group knows who is joining. We will bring you straight back here.
invite.joinedBody: You can read the group, its bills and its history. You add nothing until the owner raises your role.
invite.deadBody: This invite has expired, or it has already been used, or it was withdrawn. Ask whoever invited you for a new one.
ref.title: Invite a friend
ref.subtitle: Share your link. A reward is yours when a friend signs up with it and logs their first entry.
ref.copyError: Could not copy that. Select the text and copy it yourself.
ref.share.body: {name} is on Campus Coin and keeps their spending straight with it. Want to try? {link}
ref.capReached: All {cap} rewards earned. Your link still works for anyone who joins — there is simply nothing more to earn from it.
ref.joinedNone: Nobody yet. Share the link above, and whoever signs up with it appears here.
ref.pending.one: {count} friend has joined but has not logged an entry yet.
ref.pending.other: {count} friends have joined but have not logged an entry yet.
ref.whyBody: Signing up is one line of typing; logging an entry is what the app is for, so that is what a reward waits for.
ref.invite.notFound: That invite link is not one of ours. You can still create an account.
ref.invite.keep: Sign up with their link and it is remembered on your account — nothing else to do.
